fields.label: Finger Log

fields.description: This punch is NOT what the fingerprint device recorded - the Ingress application wrote it (the machine's _c flag = 1). Usually an HR correction made in the Ingress app; occasionally the machine's own enrolment-day adjustment. Either way it is the row somebody may later argue about. Measured 2026-08-17: the flag that moves on an HR edit is _c, NOT the _x column that looks like an override flag.
